notes:
1.9 beta 5: fixes from the first beta night.
- Virtual DJ: pick the deck AutoMix plays on (Admin > Virtual DJ) and song 1 / song 2 changes within a couple of seconds. Tap the song label on the DJ screen to correct it.
- A manager can add an AUDITION from the iPad (Rotation tab).
- The bar at the bottom of every iPad shows what ANY dance counter just did (tap it for the last 20), on every tab.
- Girls after LAST CALL can be set for each night of the week (Settings).
- The DJ screen no longer flashes for go-home-early requests (they stay on her profile). Every DJ notification makes a sound.
- 💬 Message managers on the DJ screen: it flashes on the managers' iPads; they can reply.
- Remove from tonight on the iPad (Take off… or ⋯) for a girl put on by mistake.
- A manager sees everything about a girl on her profile: nights, notes, went home, and her log.
- Champagne: FILL OUT LATER takes her off without starting the timer; FILL IN & START → START NOW starts it.
Also in 1.9: the always-on server, taps saved when the Wi-Fi drops, the Virtual DJ link, late fees per hour.
